learning_outcomes.text: Determines the force and moment acting on machine elements. Calculates stresses and deformations for static and dynamic conditions.
Defines shafts and axles, calculates according to design parameters / performs strength control.
Defines shaft-hub connections (key connections and interference fits), calculates / performs strength control.
Classifies materials used in machine elements and determines their mechanical properties.

syllabus_topics: Material definition and classification of machine elements according to their functions
Forces, moments, and stresses acting on machine elements
Strength calculation: Static and variable loading
Shafts and axles: Cylindrical shafts, profiled shafts, camshafts, crankshafts
Threaded connections: Definition, classification, areas of use, standards
Threaded connections: Force-moment transmission, strength calculation
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate in the academic calendar.
bibliography: Shigley, JE., Mechanical Engineering Design, McGraw-Hill,1986.
